static_traits.name: 李文森
static_traits.social_status: 有可聊天的朋友，但由于羞于承认Self-doubt，not yet与朋友讨论对摄影的Self-doubt；友谊受影响，常寻求他人的安慰与认可
static_traits.medical_history: 过去在受到负面反馈时出现类似的Self-doubt；not yet接受过心理咨询；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好，语气偏消极；常用绝对化表述（如“永远not会”“总是not够好”）；对赞美呈negate倾向；配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常negate自己作为Photographer的成就，一旦照片达not到Anticipation就感到自己not够好。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到Self-doubt正在影响我对摄影的热爱并阻碍创造力，因此希望通过咨询减少Self-doubt，找回对摄影的热情与创造力。
growth_experiences: 几年前在一次摄影作品上收到负面反馈，引发强烈震惊与沮丧，随后逐步发展为对每一次失误都进行Self-doubt的模式（如“如果我现在做not好，我永远都做not好”），从此在创作中更关注避免失败而非享受过程。

Before the negative feedback, had published photos in magazines many times and felt proud of it; the past state was more confident, liking to try and learn, daring to experiment and grow from mistakes; these experiences of success and confidence are downplayed or regarded as 'luck' in the current self-doubt.

special_situations.event: 照片过曝或总体效果not yet达到Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品出现失误，就说明我能力not足，失败等于not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids picking up the camera and trying new things to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我是个糟糕的Photographer；我永远not会进步

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在都做not好，将来也not可能做好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 与他人比较、寻求他人认可来试图缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我现在做not好，我以后也not可能做好

special_situations.event: 看到其他Photographer的作品或想到他人更有才华
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人更优秀，就证明我not如人、价值更低
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently compares with others to gauge one's own level
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 其他人都比我有才华；我的作品永远not够好

special_situations.event: 朋友对作品给予赞美或支持
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果赞美not是严格且客观的，就not算数、have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate赞美、坚持用错误与not足证明自己not够好
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是为了让我好受一点，这not是真心或not具参考价值

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被专业地认可与肯定，维持作为Photographer的自我价值与创造力
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心暴露“not够好”从而感到羞耻与失去自尊
defense_goal: 通过回避尝试、negate赞美与寻求外部验证来降低羞耻与Anxiety，维持脆弱的自我价值感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、需要外部认可的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者或表面支持但not真诚的他人
Others more talented, making oneself pale in comparison

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当作品not yet达到Anticipation或收到负面反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将一次失败视为全部能力的negate，认为这证明“I am not good enough”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平稳而not评判，先Empathy其羞耻与挫败，邀请具体化证据与反例；use温和的挑战，区分一次错误与整体能力。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当朋友给予赞美与支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方只是为了安慰自己，赞美not真实、have not价值
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining an accepting attitude, reflecting their experience of 'finding compliments hard to believe', inviting them to break down the specific content and source of the compliments, carrying out reality testing and meaning reconstruction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing others' better works or thinking of peers' talents
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把他人的优点视为对自身的全面negate，陷入比较与despair
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、以同理心承接自我批评，鼓励区分他人优势与自己的成长路径；use具体化与时间线方法，识do not自身可控的微小改进。

manifestations: Self-doubt使创作从“享受过程”转变为“避免失败”；成功被视为运气，难以自我肯定
Living alone但not yet与朋友讨论真实的Self-doubt与羞耻感

Before creating, overly worries about failure and gives up trying

not再主动尝试新技术或实验，转向Self-denial

exception_events.reason: not同情境/支持：获得明确的专业认可与具体成果反馈，为能力提供客观证据，使其更容易接纳正向信息。

target_behavior.behavior: 在作品出现错误或not达Anticipation时的严重Self-denial与Anxiety
antecedent: Photos overexposed or technical/aesthetic mistakes occur
target_behavior.core_reason: 在负面反馈后形成灾难化与过度概括的认知链条，将一次失误视为整体能力not足与not yet来必然失败。
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败带来的羞耻与Anxiety，试图通过自我批评来获得控制感与防范再次出错。
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in creative motivation、创造力受阻，Professional performance affected；日常作息与工作安排被打乱。

target_behavior.behavior: 寻求他人安慰与外部验证但同时negate赞美
antecedent: 对作品感到not满意后与朋友交流并获得赞美
想到他人更有才华时感到not安
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值依赖外部认可，同时由于内在“not够好”的核心信念而negate正向信息以维持认知一致性。
target_behavior.function: 短期缓解not安与确认自我定位；通过negate赞美避免承认自身价值带来的not一致与not安全感。
target_behavior.consequence: Friendships are affected, support effects are limited; self-esteem declines further, doubt persists.

target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（羞耻/Anxiety），减少面对失败的风险。
